crm_notes:
Interest: latency- and cost-sensitive realtime ranking and chat features. P95 target 60-100ms for single-turn ranking at 200 QPS; peak bursts to 1k QPS tolerated with graceful degradation. Strong cost focus: looking to reduce per-token cost via batching, prefix KV caching, and 4-bit quantized weights where quality delta < 3% on offline eval set. Quote: 'If we can hit 80ms p95 and 40% cost reduction versus our current TF serving, it's a go.'

Current setup: hybrid infra (GCP primary, fallback to on-prem for EU customers). They use internal model zoo (Llama2-13B variants, some internal distilled models). Want Redwood to run perf benchmarks vs their baseline (TF Serving w/ custom kernels) and provide recommended batching/caching/quantization profiles.

Security: SSO + SCIM required, need audit logs and KMS integration. Data residency for EU customers is a must - may require Private deployment or VPC peering.

Pricing sensitivity: procurement wants 12-month committed Dedicated pool if performance/cost numbers validated. Long-tail: interested in Optimize to drive continuous batching/caching suggestions and alert on quality regressions.
